# Conditional forms

Frozen Phase-C fixture. Do not edit: `tests/test_md_search.py` counts the notes
and the terms in them.

This is the note the spec's own question — "where did I write about conditional
forms?" — is supposed to find. The English body carries the word *conditional*
in prose; the frontmatter carries it as a tag, which is what makes the
frontmatter-vs-body distinction testable on one file.

The four forms worth keeping apart are ば, たら, なら and と. Only the last one
appears as bare kana here.
